```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(apaTables)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(lme4)
library(data.table)

```

```{r}

#Read in influence data and team member characteristics

infl <- fread("***add filepath to Team_influence_data***")

char <- fread("***add filepath to Team_member_characteristics_updated***")

infl_dat <- merge(infl, char, by = c("Unit", "ResponseId"))

infl_dat

```


Correlation Table


```{r}

corr_tab <- dplyr::select(infl_dat, -Unit, -ResponseId)

apa.cor.table(corr_tab)

```

```{r}

#scale all predictor variables

infl_dat_scaled <-  mutate(infl_dat, Expertise_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Expertise)), Similarity_to_Mean_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Similarity_to_Mean)), SpeakingTime_scaled = as.numeric(scale(SpeakingTime)), WorkContributions_scaled = as.numeric(scale(WorkContributions)), Dominance_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Dominance))) 

```


```{r}

#Visualize histogram of normailized difference data

hist(infl_dat$Norm_diff, breaks = 20)

```


```{r}

head(infl_dat_scaled)
nrow(infl_dat_scaled)

d <- glmmTMB(Norm_diff ~ Expertise_scaled + SpeakingTime_scaled + Dominance_scaled + Expertise_scaled:SpeakingTime_scaled + SpeakingTime_scaled:Dominance_scaled + WorkContributions_scaled + Similarity_to_Mean_scaled + (1|Unit), data = infl_dat_scaled, beta_family(link = "logit"))  #use this one

check_model0 <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = d)

hist(residuals(check_model0))

testUniformity(check_model0)  #KS test   

testOutliers(check_model0)
testDispersion(check_model0)  #Dispersion test
testQuantiles(check_model0)


summary(d)


```
```{r}


d2 <- glmmTMB(Norm_diff ~ Expertise_scaled + SpeakingTime_scaled + Dominance_scaled + WorkContributions_scaled + Similarity_to_Mean_scaled + (1|Unit), data = infl_dat_scaled, beta_family(link = "logit"))  #use this one


check_model0 <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = d2)

hist(residuals(check_model0))

testUniformity(check_model0)  #KS test   

testOutliers(check_model0)
testDispersion(check_model0)  #Dispersion test
testQuantiles(check_model0)


summary(d2)


```
